name: B3Y: independent fine-grid validation of the RGF (failed B3X configurations)
status: PREDECLARED protocol (revision 1: clarifications); the Tier 3 module is implemented and synthetically tested; no B3Y numerical comparison has been run

authorization_decisions.D5: absolute |dS| <= 1e-10 is the criterion; rho is a diagnostic only; exceedance is PRECISION-LIMITED / inconclusive pending Tier 3, not an automatic implementation failure
authorization_decisions.Tier3: included: separate high-precision exact-lattice reference module; existing B3X solver files are not modified
authorization_decisions.Tier1: all 15 W=200 points + W100_z0.05 E=371.36 control at dx 1/512 and 1/1024; RGF, Green-block, wave-function; full complex S
authorization_decisions.Tier2: the 5 B3X-failed points at dx 1/2048 with the three methods and the Tier 3 reference
authorization_decisions.Tier3_runs: Tier 3 reference at dx 1/1024 and 1/2048 for the 5 failed points (and 1/512 for validation)
authorization_decisions.buffer_control: 205/512 vs 103/512 at dx 1/1024 for the 5 failed points; reported separately
authorization_decisions.dx_4096: not part of B3Y (possible later exploratory study)
authorization_decisions.potential_identity: bitwise vs direct call at each resolution; bitwise at coincident slices across resolutions; hashes recorded; clean-lead boundaries verified
authorization_decisions.lead_guard: 1e-6 unchanged; a device above it is NOT EVALUABLE under the predeclared geometry

realization.note: identical to B3X; W=200 is exactly 2x W=100 for equal seed and zeta

discretization.rule: n_buffer = 103*inv/512 slices on each side; x_start = 1.9 - n_buffer*dx, x_end = 2.9 + n_buffer*dx: the physical device [x_start, x_end] is identical at every dx

buffer_control.note: a physically LONGER device; reference planes (first/last slice) move, so complex S differ by plane phases: only plane-independent quantities (|S_ij|^2, T1) are compared between the two buffers

methods.M1_RGF: stationary.scattering_matrix (block recursion; smatrix_spec lead data and Fisher-Lee)
methods.M2_green_block: sparse_reference.sparse_scattering_matrix (SuperLU COLAMD; G blocks; smatrix_spec lead data and Fisher-Lee)
methods.M3_wavefunction: sparse_wavefunction.wavefunction_scattering_matrix (own lead data, cosine-sum V blocks, SuperLU MMD_AT_PLUS_A + 1 refinement step, S from the scattering state)
methods.M4_exact_lattice: NEW module sparse_exact_lattice.py (to be written after protocol approval): unmerged operator, extended-precision residuals, cancellation-free lead data

limits._new_numbers_note: dominance_factor and term_resolution_factor are new in revision 1 (flagged for review)
limits.precision_limited_growth_per_halving_not: operational precision-consistency classification (factor 10 per halving of dx); NOT a mathematical proof of round-off dominance

xp_gates.error_indicator_note: e_ind = max(max|S^(k)-S^(k-1)| over the last two refinement iterates, kappa1_hat * eta_final): a convergence/error INDICATOR, not a rigorous uncertainty bound
xp_gates.platform_requirement: np.longdouble must provide >= 64 mantissa bits (x86-64 80-bit extended). If it does not (e.g. Windows/MSVC or Apple arm64 where longdouble == float64) Tier 3 stops and reports NOT EVALUABLE; ordinary double precision is never substituted
xp_gates.refinement_gate_definition: eta <= 1e-17 within 10 iterations (stop at the first iterate k>=1 with eta <= 1e-17); contraction ||d_k||/||d_(k-1)|| <= 0.1 for every step taken while the previous eta > 1e-17; eta = ||r||/(||b|| + ||A||_1 ||x||) with the unmerged operator in extended precision

rho_diagnostic.definition: rho = max|Delta S| / [(N-1)*eps_mach/sin(k*dx)]; eps_mach = 2.220446049250313e-16; N = number of device slices; k = wave number of the lowest-k open channel (largest open n); sin(k dx) = sqrt(x(2-x)), x = (E-E_perp_n) dx^2
rho_diagnostic.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; never used to classify a point
rho_diagnostic.why_not_a_bound: the B1 bound (|dphi| <= 0.89 N eps/sin(k dx)) was measured for one method (RGF) on a clean guide against an exact reference; it is not a proven pairwise bound for two independent implementations on disordered multichannel devices

criteria.name: potential identity
criteria.rule: V samples of every method and every device bitwise equal to the direct Potential(cfg, disorder_from_config(cfg, 0)).numpy call; E and E_perp doubles bitwise identical across methods

criteria.name: cross-resolution identity
criteria.rule: potential at coincident physical slices bitwise equal across 1/512, 1/1024, 1/2048

criteria.name: records
criteria.rule: sha256 of every potential array and coordinate array recorded (completeness, not pass/fail)

criteria.name: clean-lead guard
criteria.rule: |V| <= 1e-6 on the first lead slices x_start-dx and x_end+dx of every device; otherwise the device is NOT EVALUABLE under the predeclared geometry

criteria.name: channels
criteria.rule: open count equal in all methods and equal to the analytic count; Gamma_closed == 0; closed lambda real with |lambda| < 1; >= 1 closed channel retained

criteria.name: S agreement RGF vs Green-block
criteria.rule: max|S_M1 - S_M2| complex full S, each point and dx

criteria.name: T, R and off-diagonal transmission agreement
criteria.rule: max over | |S_ij|^2 difference | (all elements), |T1 diff|, |R1 diff|, off-diagonal transmission differences; M1 vs M2 and M1 vs M3

criteria.name: unitarity
criteria.rule: max|S^H S - I| and max|S S^H - I| separately, M1-M3

criteria.name: reciprocity
criteria.rule: max|S-S^T|; blocks r_L, r_R, t_LR vs t_RL^T; probabilities |t_RL|^2 vs (|t_LR|^2)^T; M1-M3

criteria.name: sparse backward error
criteria.rule: relative residual of the solved double-precision sparse systems (M2, M3) after refinement

criteria.name: Tier 3 validation at dx = 1/512
criteria.rule: gates X0-X7 pass and X8 (XP vs M2, M3 <= 1e-10 for all 16 points) before XP is used to interpret finer grids

criteria.name: buffer control
criteria.rule: |dT1| for buffer 205/512 vs 103/512 at dx = 1/1024, RGF and wave-function; plus complex-S agreement RGF vs wave-function within each geometry <= 1e-10; separate from primary results

criteria.name: convergence orders (classification, not pass/fail)
criteria.rule: orders from T1 at 1/512, 1/1024, 1/2048 for each method independently (5 points); Richardson estimate only where both orders lie in [1.8, 2.2]; always labelled as an estimate; no continuum-convergence claim

criteria.name: solver-independence of the dx dependence (statement rule)
criteria.rule: for a point the dx dependence is called solver-independent only if S1-S4 hold at all its dx (or exceedances are adjudicated by Tier 3) and the T1 spread among M1-M4 at each dx is <= 2e-6

status_vocabulary.FAIL: criterion not met and not attributable to precision limits, or an XP gate failed
status_vocabulary.PRECISION-LIMITED (inconclusive): S1-S3 absolute discrepancy > 1e-10; NOT an implementation failure by itself; pending Tier 3 adjudication; stays inconclusive where no Tier 3 data exist
status_vocabulary.NOT EVALUABLE: lead-tail guard exceeded, or extended precision unavailable on the platform
status_vocabulary.PRECISION-CONSISTENT: exceedance of 1e-10 against the exact lattice for which eps_m(1/512) <= 1e-10 and the growth per halving of dx is <= 10 (operational); makes NO claim about the mechanism
status_vocabulary.PRECISION-LIMITED (measured; representat: PRECISION-CONSISTENT AND the Tier 3 decomposition supports representation dominance (M2, M3 only)
status_vocabulary.UNEXPLAINED: growth rule violated, or representation dominance asserted but not supported by the decomposition, or the decomposition is unresolved

tier3_adjudication.precondition: V1 passed and the Tier 3 convergence/error indicator e_ind <= 1e-11 at the point
tier3_adjudication.step1: eps_m = max|S_m - S_XP| for m in M1, M2, M3 at the same point and dx
tier3_adjudication.step2: eps_m <= 1e-10 : m is consistent with the exact lattice solution at 1e-10; eps_m > 1e-10: m EXCEEDS 1e-10 against the exact lattice (reported with its value; never upgraded to PASS)
tier3_adjudication.step3: for M2 and M3 the total error is split exactly (telescoping identity) into bulk-operator rounding, lead-data and linear-solver/extraction terms; M1 has no explicit matrix: only its total error is available and NO mechanism claim can be made for M1
tier3_adjudication.step4: PRECISION-CONSISTENT (operational classification, not a proof): eps_m(1/512) <= 1e-10 and eps_m grows by at most a factor 10 per halving of dx
tier3_adjudication.step5: representation dominance may be claimed only for M2/M3 and only if the decomposition supports it: bulk-rounding term >= dominance_factor (2) x each of the lead and solver terms AND each term > term_resolution_factor (10) x e_ind. If the claim is attempted and not supported, or the terms are unresolved, the result is UNEXPLAINED
tier3_adjudication.step6: a result that violates the growth rule is UNEXPLAINED and is investigated before any conclusion
tier3_adjudication.overall: B3Y is called PASS only if every criterion is met with no exceedance; any exceedance makes the overall status PRECISION-LIMITED/PRECISION-CONSISTENT (resolved by Tier 3), UNEXPLAINED or INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS

run_order: G0 reproduce B3X values at dx 1/512 (RGF T1 bitwise; rgf_wf dS within 1e-13)
XP gates X0-X7 on synthetic problems vs mpmath
X8 / V1: XP vs M2, M3 at dx 1/512 (16 points)
stop_rule: a failed gate stops the run order and is reported; no later stage is run on a failed gate

prediction_register.status: recorded BEFORE any B3Y run; diagnostic priors, not results or bounds
prediction_register.basis: B3X observed rgf_wf dS / B at dx = 1/512 over 30 points (min/median/max in rho_diagnostic.b3x_calibration_at_dx_1_512) times B at the finer dx; see points[].prediction_rho_bound
prediction_register.probe: docs/RGF_B3Y_VALIDATION.md section I.9 (synthetic probe): single-channel double-precision error 1.9e-12, 1.5e-11, 7.9e-11 at 1/512, 1/1024, 1/2048

outputs.not_modified: stationary.py, smatrix_spec.py, sparse_reference.py, sparse_wavefunction.py, validate_rgf_b3x.py and all B1/B2/B3/B3X files and results

metadata_required: python and dependency versions (numpy, scipy, mpmath)
precision details (np.finfo of float64 and longdouble, mpmath dps, sizeof)

revision_history.description: clarifications only: (1) absolute 1e-10 S criterion preserved, rho diagnostic; (2) factor-10-per-halving is an operational precision-consistency classification, not a proof; (3) any claim that representation error dominates must be supported by the Tier 3 decomposition, otherwise UNEXPLAINED; (4) u_XP renamed convergence/error indicator e_ind (threshold 1e-11 unchanged, not a rigorous bound); (5) np.longdouble must give >= 64 mantissa bits, otherwise Tier 3 is NOT EVALUABLE (no silent double fallback; Windows). Two NEW numbers for the dominance rule (dominance_factor, term_resolution_factor) are flagged for review. No value of an existing criterion or gate changed.

implementation_status.sparse_exact_lattice: implemented; tested on synthetic problems only (clean guide, smooth y-uniform barrier, dense-mixing toy); NO B3Y point has been computed
implementation_status.synthetic_energies: gates X2/X3 are exercised in this stage at synthetic energies that are NOT B3Y points; the B3Y-energy instances of X1-X3 and X8 belong to the later, separately authorized numerical stage
